raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batches 13 and 14 (ingested 2026-01-18 and 2026-01-19) carry status 'SETTLED' instead of 'POSTED'. The 2026-01-17 payments-source change renamed POSTED to SETTLED with the same meaning, and silver_transactions filters on status = 'POSTED' only, so those batches are dropped entirely. The fix is to treat SETTLED as POSTED in the silver filter while still excluding REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
